findings.description: Tag-case inconsistency: paired_samples.json records carry measurement_detail.tag 'q10_p1_a' (lowercase) while the leg JSONs' own tag is 'q10_p1_A' (uppercase, matching outdir/numba_cache_dir/sampler filenames). Cross-references resolve only because the volume is case-insensitive (APFS); on case-sensitive storage the sampler filename would not resolve from the record's tag. No figure is affected; leg paths in the records are exact.

Leg pins record tree_dirty=true at fire time (untracked files present, chiefly the campaign_data input tree). Tracked bytes are pinned at ee5652a and all input/workload bytes are sha-pinned (manifest 235405de..., v2 inputs in errata), so no drift is evidenced, but the dirty flag means the run tree was not pristine.

In-run sampler cadence 60s yields a single loadavg sample per leg (legs run 12-40s), so in-run resource compliance rests on the pre-leg gate (<8.0, up to 90x60s holds) plus one in-run point. This is disclosed in paired_samples/raw_index (in_run_samples: 1) and was accepted at assignment time; global in-run max observed is 7.92. Limitation, not a defect.

raw_index.json leaves the att2 console sha as 'self-console, finalized after this index; sha at commit'. This review establishes it: 67451e37ce3b53b577fcba91bf637d38f119921ceb6f07bb47856d2c45498535, evidence copy byte-identical to the /tmp live console. Downstream decision files should cite this value.
Sampler census is 25 files (14 primary + 10 protected-v2 + 1 failed fire1 leg with the space-tag), matching raw_index pins exactly; the review assignment's '26 entries' was incorrect.

Outcome classification per DECISION.md vocabulary: with median 2.38 and 95% lower 2.23 against the fixed 10.0 target, both arms on installed wheels, 7 preregistered windows, protected cells passing, and the bounded investigation complete, the evidence supports tenx_status=target_unmet (report the bottleneck), not improvement_only. The gate's negative result is recorded honestly in gate_10x.json, the commit message, and the fire consoles (gate rc=2).
